name: merge_worktrees
description: Merge group branches into the change branch; agent resolves conflicts.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the integration git checkout that group branches are merged into.

groupIds.description: Group IDs to merge, in order. Each resolves to the branch git.GROUP_BRANCH.format(name=id). Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings.

modelBuilder.description: Model identifier passed to the conflict-resolution agent. Falls back to the agent's default when omitted.

maxResolutionAttempts.description: Max agent attempts to resolve a single conflicted branch before it is marked unresolved. Clamped server-side to [1, 3].

preflight.description: If true, first prove the complete ordered merge set in a disposable worktree so a conflict is never discovered in the supplied integration checkout.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling per conflict-resolution agent call.

merged.description: Branches merged cleanly with no conflicts.

conflicts.description: Branches that produced merge conflicts, regardless of whether they were later resolved.

resolved.description: Conflicted branches the agent successfully resolved and committed.

unresolved.description: Branches left unresolved after all resolution attempts, or that failed to merge outright (no conflict markers).

errors.description: Merge failures with no conflict markers: absent branch, dirty-index guard, hook failure, etc.

mergeState.description: Routable verdict for downstream tasks: 'merged' only when unresolved is empty.

tokenUsed.description: Total LLM tokens consumed across all conflict-resolution attempts.

costUsd.description: Total USD cost of conflict-resolution attempts, rounded to 6 decimals.

commit.description: HEAD commit SHA of repoPath after merging.
